title: Typed property value shapes in the complete editable WinUI image and a standalone ordinal-storage experiment

typed_property_census.scope: Select sized t/T symbols naming StyledProperty, EffectiveValue, BindingEntry or LocalValueBindingObserver as a generic. The first matching generic in the demangled name defines the payload. Sum unique address/size pairs across aliases. Peel a single Option before classifying the outermost payload; preserve types without a resolvable source declaration as separate groups. One range with aliases from multiple groups is counted only in the shared category. Per-category distinct type counts are not additive.
typed_property_census.evidence: The 111 unit enum payload types include a nullable specialization. They resolve to 110 unique declarations, all fieldless, Copy and derived PartialEq. The inventory records their original source path and explicit discriminants.
typed_property_census.analysis_script:
from pathlib import Path
import gzip,re,sys,json,collections
import tomllib
from functools import lru_cache
repo=Path(sys.argv[2])
crates={}
for path in (repo/'src').rglob('Cargo.toml'):
 try:
  doc=tomllib.loads(path.read_text());pkg=doc.get('package',{}).get('name')
  if pkg:crates[doc.get('lib',{}).get('name',pkg.replace('-','_'))]=path.parent
 except (OSError,ValueError):pass
@lru_cache(None)
def lookup(p):
 parts=p.split('::');name=parts[-1];base=crates.get(parts[0]);
 if not base or '<' in p:return 'named framework, unresolved'
 prefix=base.joinpath(*parts[1:-1])
 for path in (prefix.with_suffix('.rs'),prefix/'mod.rs',prefix/'lib.rs'):
  if not path.is_file():continue
  s=path.read_text(errors='ignore')
  pattern=r'\benum\s+'+re.escape(name)+r'\s*\{([^}]+)\}'
  m=re.search(pattern,s)
  if m:
   body=re.sub(r'//[^\n]*','',m.group(1))
   body=re.sub(r'#\[[^\]]*\]','',body)
   return 'unit-only enum verified in source' if '(' not in body and '{' not in body else 'payload enum'
  if re.search(r'\bstruct\s+'+re.escape(name)+r'\b',s):return 'struct (including flags)'
 return 'named framework, unresolved'
src=Path(sys.argv[1]);raw=collections.defaultdict(set); families=collections.defaultdict(set);types=collections.defaultdict(set)
markers=['::styled_property::StyledProperty<','::property_store::effective_value::EffectiveValue<','::property_store::binding_entry::BindingEntry<','::property_store::binding_entry::BindingValues<','::property_store::binding_entry::BoxedBindingEntry<','::property_store::local_value_binding_observer::LocalValueBindingObserver<']
for line in (gzip.open(src,'rt') if src.suffix=='.gz' else src.open()):
 x=line.split(' ',3)
 if len(x)!=4 or x[2] not in ('t','T'):continue
 addr=int(x[0],16);sz=int(x[1],16);sym=x[3]; found=[(sym.index(m),m) for m in markers if m in sym]
 if not found:continue
 i,m=min(found);i+=len(m);lv=1
 for j in range(i,len(sym)):
  if sym[j]=='<':lv+=1
  if sym[j]=='>':
   lv-=1
   if lv==0:break
 t=sym[i:j];p=t;nullable=''; 
 if p.startswith('core::option::Option<') and p.endswith('>'):
  p=p[len("core::option::Option<"):-1];nullable='optional '
 if p.startswith('ferroui_base::type_system::Ref<'):g='Ferro Ref'
 elif p.startswith('ferroui_base::element_ref::ElementRef<'):g='Ferro ElementRef'
 elif p.startswith('alloc::rc::Rc<'):g='Rust Rc'
 elif p.startswith('alloc::sync::Arc<'):g='Rust Arc'
 elif p.split('::')[-1] in ['bool','i8','u8','i16','u16','i32','u32','i64','u64','usize','isize','f64','f32','char']:g='primitive'
 elif p=='alloc::string::String':g='String'
 elif p.startswith(('ferroui_','xamlx::')):g=lookup(p)
 else:g='other'
 raw[addr,sz].add(g);families[addr,sz].add(m.split('::')[-1].strip('<'));types[addr,sz].add(t)
out=collections.Counter(); fam=collections.Counter(); distinct=collections.defaultdict(set)
for k,ss in raw.items():
 label=next(iter(ss)) if len(ss)==1 else 'shared code across payload classes';out[label]+=k[1];fam['/'.join(sorted(families[k]))]+=k[1];distinct[label].update(types[k])
print({k:(v,len(distinct[k])) for k,v in out.most_common()});print(fam.most_common());print('unique address bytes',sum(out.values()),'ranges',len(raw))

print(json.dumps({'physical_text_bytes':sum(out.values()),'physical_ranges':len(raw),'categories':{k:{'text_bytes':v,'distinct_payload_types':len(distinct[k]),'type_names':sorted(distinct[k])} for k,v in out.most_common()},'families':dict(fam.most_common())}))

ordinal_experiment.method: Rust 1.99.0 on Linux x86-64. For each of 34 blocks shuffle every combination of build and workload with seed 496303. Each fresh process runs 2,000,000 operations on CPU 6 using thread CPU time. Discard the first 3 blocks. Form candidate/native ratios within each remaining block. Report the median and the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 4,000 resampled block medians.

modes.native: Concrete enum effective and optional base fields, native priority kernel per enum type.
modes.word: One shared NonZeroU32 state kernel. Convert at the typed boundary by generated exhaustive matches.
modes.byte: One shared NonZeroU8 state kernel. Every observed declaration has fewer than 255 variants.
modes.cached: Byte kernel plus a typed effective-value read cache. The base retains its byte encoding.

limits: Standalone property priority kernel. Both builds have typed callback metadata and expose the actual enum to the notification sink. Object storage, property lookup, bindings, coercion callbacks with reentrancy and full framework notification delivery are outside this experiment.

Read-only runs sample each property at its default enumerable value. The write replay selects changing values, priorities, coercion and reevaluation. The digest checks all declared variant encodings and original discriminants; event counts and accumulated readbacks must match across all arms.
Sharing coverage and eligible machine-code bytes are different quantities. These small fixture binary sizes do not predict an application delta.
ordinal_experiment.replay_files_python:
import json, pathlib, sys
report = json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())["ordinal_experiment"]
pathlib.Path("main.rs").write_text(report["source"])
out, names = [], []
for i, (_, _, representation, values) in enumerate(report["declaration_inventory"]):
    name = "E" + str(i)
    names.append(name)
    if representation:
        out.append("#[repr(" + representation + ")]")
    variants = ", ".join(v + (" = " + n if n is not None else "") for v,n in values)
    out.append("#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)] enum " + name + " {" + variants + "}")
    encode = ",".join("Self::" + v + "=>" + str(i + 1) for i,(v,_) in enumerate(values))
    decode = ",".join(str(i + 1) + "=>Some(Self::" + v + ")" for i,(v,_) in enumerate(values))
    out.append("impl Codec for " + name + " { const N: u32=" + str(len(values)) + "; fn encode(self)->u32 {match self {" + encode + "}} fn decode(id:u32)->Option<Self>{match id {" + decode + ",_=>None}} fn discriminant(self)->i64 {self as i64}}")
out.append("fn registered()->Vec<Box<dyn Lane>>{vec![" + ",".join("Box::new(Property::<" + n + ">::new())" for n in names) + "]}")
pathlib.Path("enums.rs").write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n")
ordinal_experiment.binary_invocation: Run rustc with the listed flags, the matching cfg arguments, main.rs and -o <mode>. Run the resulting binary once per sampled case with either read or write. The per-process columns are mode, type count, declaration digest, aggregate state bytes, value checksum, weighted notification count, thread CPU nanoseconds and wall nanoseconds.

runtime_type_names.scope: Dedicated x86-64 AnyValue::any_value_type_name leaves. For each matched, decode its RIP-relative pointer and literal slice length, verify the UTF-8 bytes are in .rodata, integrate the union of string ranges and match each FDE to the leaf start and length. Count one eight-byte search index entry per FDE. String literals may have other inbound references. These are attribution bytes, not a recoverable saving.
